name: Columns
description: Side-by-side layout with N equal or custom-width columns, where each column contains arbitrary mixed content (text, image, list, links). Use when there are 3+ columns, OR when a 2-column layout contains non-standard content (not the typical text+image hero pair). Don't use for a 2-column text+image hero (use marquee) or a 2-column icon+text grid (use icon-block).
visualSignals: 2–4 columns of similar-height content, each column self-contained. No single large hero image.

domInput.columns: N (determined by number of <td> cells in content row)

cols.contains: h3 + p content for first column
h3 + p content for second column
h3 + p content for third column

domInput.notes: Each row becomes a grid row; each cell becomes a column. Keep cell counts consistent across rows. Layout is purely determined by number of <td> cells.
